name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
benefit: Health cover up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year for hospitalisation at empanelled hospitals
verification_note: Seed data written from public knowledge; confirm rules, amounts and URLs on the official source before relying on them.
notes: Eligibility is decided by the SECC deprivation and occupation criteria.

rules.text: Annual family income is at or below about Rs 3 lakh (approximation — the official deprivation/occupation list decides)
Work is daily wage, farm labour or unemployed category

documents.name: Aadhaar (identity only — do not enter the number in this app)

steps: Check your eligibility on the official portal or with a local service centre
Carry your Aadhaar and ration card to an empanelled hospital or Ayushman Mitra help desk
Get your card generated and verified at the desk
Note the application or card number and keep it for follow-up
